name: firefighter's axe
description: Fibreglass haft, pick on one side, edge on the other, the paint worn back to steel where a hundred hands have held it. It goes through a door. It goes through riot plate. Everything in the block hears it happen.
notes: T81 · THE legendary seed the GDD names three times (Principle 6, Part X legendary items, the Manifesto). Hardest hitter, only profile that ignores riot plate outright (pierce 2 >= armor 1 with room to spare), best reach — and the LOUDEST swing in the game at noise 30, double bare hands, plus carry weight 8. Found in the police table only, which is the kind node.the-terraces.fire-station carries; weight swept at BASE_LOOT_WEIGHT 24 over 200 full police sweeps (1 -> 12.5%, 2 -> 22.0%, 3 -> 30.5%, 4 -> 41.0%, where it is as likely as a pistol and no longer a legendary); at the shipped BASE_LOOT_WEIGHT 18, weight 2 measures 32.0% over 300 sweeps. So roughly one thorough run in three ever holds it.
